pages.text: $(bold)Trotting Wagons$(): a wagon hitched to a horse with storage in the back. Lead the horse, the wagon follows. This is the first bulk transport.$(br2)$(bold)Caravans & Convoys$() wagons travel in trains behind a leader, carry chests, and can be sent along routes between stops.

Roads matter: Macaw's paths and Supplementaries' ropes and pulleys make a road and a loading dock out of nothing.$(br2)A wagon of zinc clusters from the mountains to the capital is the first trade route this server will have.
